speaker: alse_pinder
text: It is white, mistress. I washed it before we came. The blue is out.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Let me see the fold. White. That will do for Ascension, and for Sunday, if Sunday is when they read the paper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One band, and it is white. You were very still last night, and this morning you have done the thing.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I did it in the yard. Nobody in the lane asked me what colour it had been.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Nobody needs to ask. Come in. We are early, and we will not stand in the porch inventing a sermon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No sermon from me. The band is white. That is the whole of the news.
